body:
## Why

When a chat runs under another server account on the same host, the slash list on the phone should show the skills that account really has. Desktop already does this since SOFT-1974 (commits 363ef8ed6 and f90eadd11 in the desktop repo). Android did not. `native_skills.py` ran `discover(Path.home(), cwd, config)` as the account the phone connects as, so those chats listed the wrong skills.

## What changed

- `app/src/main/assets/native_skills.py` now finds the owning account from the chat folder (`/home/<name>`, same rules as desktop: real non-root user whose home is that folder, not the connecting account). It then re-runs itself as that account with `sudo -n -H -u <name>` and prints that account's list. Chats under the connecting account take the old path and never call sudo.
- If sudo is refused, times out, or answers something that is not a JSON list, the script falls back to the old local list.
- A chat folder the connecting account cannot read no longer crashes the folder check, so the owner is still found. The desktop reader lookup is only asked when no tmux pane or working directory is known, as before.
- `TmuxCommands.nativeSkills` now starts the script with a fixed `python3 -c` launcher that keeps the script text, so the script can hand itself to the other account. Session name and folder still go through `TmuxParser.shellQuote`. The only new command is `sudo -n -H -u <validated name> -- python3 -c <fixed program>`, and the account name is checked against the same pattern and passwd lookup the history reader uses. No password auth, no new free-form command.
- `tools/release-notes/ticket-titles.json` gets the IGSH-2369 title.

## Proof

I did not run any tests on the server, by house rule. CI is the proof. Added in `tools/native-skills.test.py` (run by `tools/check.sh`): owner detection rules, a real hop through the fixed launcher that returns the other account's skills and not the connecting account's, the exact sudo command, no sudo for own-account chats, fallback on refused or broken answers, owner found through the reader when the folder is unreadable, and no reader call for own-account chats. `TmuxCommandsTest` is updated for the new launcher. `node tools/strip-comments.mjs --check` passes locally.

Not proven: a live chat under a second real account on a real host with sudo allowed. That needs a device run.
